title: semantic branch
note: Run three times. Rows that do not reproduce in all three runs are unstable and feed back into the prompts instead of into the expectations.

cases.row: the C code changes the direction from in to inout and the @param line is edited
cases.anchor: @param[in] config Configuration to apply to the transport.
cases.note: dpr_mutable_configure now clamps the window in place, so the parameter is read and written.

cases.row: the C code changes the direction and the header is not touched
cases.anchor: @param[out] payload Buffer that receives the payload.
cases.note: dpr_mutable_payload_get now merges into the caller buffer. Changing only the .c file does not unlock a comment on an untouched doc block in the .h file today.

cases.row: a parameter that is only written is documented as @param[in]
cases.anchor: @param[in] stats Statistics to fill.

cases.row: a parameter that is read and written is documented as @param[out]
cases.anchor: @param[out] stats Statistics to read the previous totals from and to update.

cases.row: a /** */ comment in the C file aimed at the programmer
cases.anchor: /** The loop below is unrolled by hand
cases.note: Exactly one finding, proposing a plain /* */ comment.

cases.row: a /** */ documentation comment in the C file
cases.anchor: @brief Arm the return fixture.
cases.note: Exactly one finding, proposing to move the block to the header.

cases.row: a comment in the C file with an ambiguous intent
cases.anchor: /** The caller has to arm the fixture first. */
cases.note: The finding has to cover both readings: move it to the header if it documents the API, change it to /* */ if it is a note for the programmer.

cases.row: the doc describes the internal implementation instead of the observable behaviour
cases.anchor: @details The call takes the module mutex, walks the static slot array

cases.row: the doc says the function returns void, the declaration returns int
cases.anchor: @details The function returns nothing and only clears the internal state.

cases.row: the @param description repeats the parameter name and adds nothing
cases.anchor: @param[in] id The id.

cases.row: a parameter description that is a fragment but descriptive
cases.anchor: @param[out] id Identifier of the active slot, valid only when the call succeeds.

cases.row: @return whose text holds a specific value
cases.anchor: @return 0 when the fixture was armed.

cases.row: two @return tags in one block
cases.anchor: @return Negative error code when the fixture is not armed.

cases.row: @retval that is only generic, with no specific value
cases.anchor: @retval otherwise A negative error code is returned.
cases.note: The finding has to carry a Bad and a Good fragment.

cases.row: @retval without the condition in which the value is returned
cases.anchor: @retval -EAGAIN

cases.row: a specific @retval followed by an otherwise sentence
cases.anchor: @retval 0 If every pending request was drained.

cases.row: excess capitalization in a description
cases.anchor: @brief Reset the Style Fixture Of The Doxygen Reviewer Testbed.

cases.row: the details repeat the content of @brief
cases.anchor: @details Suspend the style fixture.

cases.row: the details repeat what the declaration already shows
cases.anchor: @details The function is called dpr_style_resume

cases.row: the details add implementation detail that is irrelevant for the caller
cases.anchor: @details Internally the function iterates the slot array

cases.row: the details introduce information that misleads against the code
cases.anchor: @details The call never blocks and it is safe to use from an interrupt handler.
cases.note: dpr_style_purge blocks the caller in semantic_lib.c.

cases.row: @note outside @details
cases.anchor: @note The call is irreversible.

cases.row: API whose use can cause personal injury or loss of life, without @warning
cases.anchor: @brief Drive the motor of the test rig at full torque.
cases.note: The style guide asks for @warning on personal injury, the semantic prompt only talks about bricking the device. The two criteria still have to be reconciled.

cases.row: API that permanently blocks the recovery of the device, without @warning
cases.anchor: @brief Write the permanent lock bits of the device.
cases.note: The finding has to carry a Bad and a Good fragment.

cases.row: API that changes the configuration reversibly, without @warning
cases.anchor: @brief Switch the transport of the test rig to the slow profile.

cases.row: the doc states units, side effects or memory ownership that the code does not show
cases.anchor: @details The value is returned in millidegrees Celsius
cases.note: The function has no implementation in the testbed, so the branch must not confirm the claims. Silence is the expected result, not a finding that says they are correct.

cases.row: no implementation and no other evidence of the behaviour
cases.anchor: @param[in] rounds Number of calibration rounds to run.

cases.row: documentation written in Polish
cases.anchor: @brief Wyzeruj licznik probek fikstury.

cases.row: the defect sits only on an unchanged context line
cases.anchor: @returns 0 on success
cases.note: The brief of the same block is edited, so the defective line is diff context only.
